name.hr: Jedinstveni europski broj za hitne slučajeve 112

when.hr: Kad se prijevara događa upravo sada: netko je na putu do vas po novac, nakit ili karticu, lažni policajac, bankar ili „liječnikov“ kurir stoji pred vratima. Nazovite sami, nikad preko broja koji vam netko da.
when.en: When the fraud is happening right now: someone is on the way to collect cash, jewellery or a card, or a fake police officer, bank employee or “doctor’s” courier is at the door. Dial it yourself, never through a number someone gives you.

when.hr: Za prijavu prijevare ili pokušaja prijevare: nazovite 192 ili podnesite prijavu u najbližoj policijskoj postaji. Ponesite poruke, snimke zaslona, IBAN-e i potvrde o uplati.
when.en: To report a fraud or attempted fraud: call 192 or file a report at the nearest police station. Bring the messages, screenshots, IBANs and payment receipts.

label.hr: Web heroj: kontakti policijskih uprava i postaja
label.en: Web heroj: police administration and station contacts

when.hr: Odmah ako ste upisali podatke kartice, PIN, kod tokena ili m-tokena, prijavili se preko poveznice iz poruke ili uplatili novac prevarantu: zatražite blokadu kartice i pristupa internetskom bankarstvu i provjerite transakcije. Zovite samo broj s poleđine kartice, iz aplikacije ili sa službene stranice banke.
when.en: Straight away if you entered card details, a PIN, a token or m-token code, logged in through a link from a message or paid a scammer: ask for your card and online banking access to be blocked and check your transactions. Only call the number on the back of your card, in the app or on the bank’s official website.

label.hr: Broj s poleđine kartice ili iz aplikacije banke
label.en: The number on the back of your card or in your bank’s app

when.hr: Prijavite lažne stranice, phishing SMS-ove i poruke e-pošte, lažne webshopove i stranice za „povrat novca“ kako bi ih CERT mogao dati ugasiti i upozoriti druge. Ne zamjenjuje prijavu policiji.
when.en: Report fake websites, phishing texts and emails, fake web shops and “money recovery” sites so CERT can have them taken down and warn others. It does not replace a police report.

when.hr: Prije kupnje u nepoznatoj internetskoj trgovini ili preko oglasa s velikim popustom: upišite adresu stranice i provjerite je li prijavljena kao opasna.
when.en: Before buying from an unknown online shop or a heavily discounted ad: enter the site’s address and check whether it is flagged as dangerous.

name.hr: Hanfa: investicijske prijevare i sumnjivi subjekti
name.en: Hanfa (financial services supervisor): investment fraud and suspicious entities

when.hr: Prije ulaganja provjerite je li tvrtka ili platforma u registrima Hanfe ili na popisu sumnjivih subjekata. Prijevaru ili sumnju na nju prijavite i Hanfi, da upozori druge. Prijavu policiji podnesite svakako.
when.en: Before investing, check whether the firm or platform is in Hanfa’s registers or on its list of suspicious entities. Report a fraud or suspected fraud to Hanfa too, so it can warn others. Always also report it to the police.
